description: This file defines the 'Tab' class for managing browser tab interactions within Playwright, including event handling, snapshot capturing, navigation, console message processing, and modal/dialog management.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Represents a browser tab, managing its lifecycle, events, snapshots, and interactions.

methods.name: forPage
methods.description: Retrieves the Tab instance associated with a given Playwright page.

methods.name: collectConsoleMessages
methods.description: Collects console messages and errors from a Playwright page.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Tab by collecting console messages and requests, and running any init scripts.

methods.name: modalStates
methods.description: Returns current modal states.

methods.name: setModalState
methods.description: Adds a modal state and emits an event.

methods.name: clearModalState
methods.description: Removes a modal state.

methods.name: _dialogShown
methods.description: Handles dialog events by setting modal state.

methods.name: _downloadStarted
methods.description: Handles download start, saving the file and updating download status.

methods.name: _clearCollectedArtifacts
methods.description: Clears stored console messages and requests.

methods.name: _handleConsoleMessage
methods.description: Stores a console message.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles tab closure, cleaning up artifacts.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the tab's title.

methods.name: lastTitle
methods.description: Returns the last known title.

methods.name: isCurrentTab
methods.description: Checks if this tab is the current active tab.

methods.name: waitForLoadState
methods.description: Waits for the page to reach a specific load state.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the tab to a specified URL.

methods.name: consoleMessages
methods.description: Retrieves console messages filtered by level.

methods.name: requests
methods.description: Returns the set of requests made by the page.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the tab's current state, including URL, title, modal states, console messages, and downloads.

methods.name: _javaScriptBlocked
methods.description: Checks if JavaScript execution is blocked due to modal dialogs.

methods.name: _raceAgainstModalStates
methods.description: Runs an action while racing against modal state changes.

methods.name: waitForCompletion
methods.description: Waits for a callback to complete, considering modal states.

methods.name: refLocator
methods.description: Resolves a reference to a locator.

methods.name: refLocators
methods.description: Resolves multiple references to locators.

methods.name: waitForTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a specified timeout, considering JavaScript blocking.
